cards.front: ¿Te importa sujetar mi copa un momento mientras voy al baño?
cards.back: Do you mind holding my drink for a second while I go to the toilet?

cards.front: No te estoy pidiendo que me la sujetes toda la noche.
cards.back: I'm not asking you to hold it all night.

cards.front: No te la sujetaré a no ser que me lo pidas de manera amable.
cards.back: I won't hold it for you unless you ask me nicely.

cards.front: ¿No se supone que me estabas sujetando la copa?
cards.back: Weren't you supposed to be holding my drink for me?

cards.front: La sujeté durante un tiempo, pero estuviste mucho tiempo en el baño.
cards.back: I held it for a while but you were in the toilet for a long time.

cards.front: Me aburrí de sujetarla, así que la dejé en alguna parte del suelo.
cards.back: I got bored of holding it so I left it on the floor somewhere.

cards.front: ¿Llevas mucho tiempo sujetando su copa?
cards.back: Have you been holding his glass for long?

cards.front: Es como si hubiera estado sujetándola toda la noche.
cards.back: It feels like I've been holding it all night.

cards.front: Nunca antes he sujetado un vaso tan pesado como éste.
cards.back: I haven't ever held a glass as heavy as this before.

cards.front: Yo que tú no le sujetaría nada a ese imbécil.
cards.back: If I were you, I wouldn't hold anything for that imbecile.

cards.front: ¿Se lo habrías sujetado si fuera más guapo?
cards.back: Would you have held it for him if he were better looking?

cards.front: Bueno, si me lo hubiera pedido de manera agradable, lo habría sujetado... ¡y si fuera Brad Pitt, lo habría sujetado también!
cards.back: Well, if he had asked me nicely, I would have held it... and if he were Brad Pitt, I would have held it too!

cards.front: Ojalá no se lo hubiera sujetado.
cards.back: I wish I hadn't held it for him.

cards.front: ¿Podrías haberte acostumbrado a sujetárselo?
cards.back: Could you have got used to holding it for him?

cards.front: Puede que yo se lo hubiera sujetado si no hubiera habido aquella pelea en el bar.
cards.back: I might have held it for him if there hadn't been that fight in the bar.

cards.front: Tendré que sujetar estas gafas con cinta hasta que tenga dinero suficiente para ir a la óptica.
cards.back: I'll have to tape these glasses together until I have enough money to go to the optician's.

cards.front: No puedes dejar los cables colgando allí; por lo menos sujétalos al techo con un poco de cinta por el momento.
cards.back: You can't leave those cables hanging there; at least tape them to the ceiling for the time being.

cards.front: No se permite a los estudiantes sujetar sus pósteres a las paredes con cinta adhesiva.
cards.back: Students are not allowed to tape their posters to the wall.

cards.front: Colgamos todos los menús de comida para llevar en el corcho que hay en la cocina.
cards.back: We pin all the takeaway menus to the cork board in the kitchen.

cards.front: Esta moqueta se está soltando; tendremos que sujetarla otra vez al suelo.
cards.back: This carpet is coming loose; we need to pin it back to the floor.

cards.front: Vas a perder esos papeles; ¿por qué no los sujetas con un alfiler?
cards.back: You're going to lose those papers; why don't you pin them together?

cards.front: Abróchense los cinturones de seguridad.
cards.back: Fasten your seatbelts.

cards.front: Cariño, ¿me puedes echar una mano para abrocharme el sujetador, por favor?
cards.back: Darling, can you lend me a hand to fasten my bra please?

cards.front: El velcro es un invento maravilloso para abrochar la ropa.
cards.back: Velcro is a fantastic invention for fastening clothes.

cards.front: Deberías sujetar esa bolsa de cereales con una pinza; si no los cereales se pondrán duros.
cards.back: You should peg that cereal bag; otherwise the cereal will go stale.

cards.front: Tenemos que sujetar la tienda al suelo antes de que empiece a llover.
cards.back: We need to peg this tent to the ground before it starts raining.

cards.front: ¿Cómo puedo sujetar la ropa a la cuerda de tender si no tengo pinzas?
cards.back: How can I peg these clothes to the washing line if I don't have any pegs?

cards.front: Antes de empezar a operar al perro, tendremos que sujetarlo a la mesa con una correa.
cards.back: Before we begin to operate on the dog we will have to strap him to this table.

cards.front: ¿Qué vamos a utilizar para atar las bicis al techo del coche?
cards.back: What are we going to use to strap the bikes to the car roof?

cards.front: No podrá escapar si le atamos a la silla con correas.
cards.back: He won't be able to escape if we strap him to the chair.

cards.front: Puede que parezca muy despistado, pero no se lo puedes reprochar.
cards.back: He may seem very absent-minded, but you can't hold that against him.

cards.front: Cuanto más tiempo le guardes rencor, más sufrirás, y eso no cambiará su vida de ninguna manera.
cards.back: The longer you hold it against him, the more you'll suffer, and it won't make any difference to his life.

cards.front: Ella se casó con él debido a tu envidia inútil; llevas años reprochándoselo.
cards.back: She got married to him because of your pointless jealousy; you've held it against her for years.

cards.front: Permítame recordarle que está usted ante un tribunal de justicia. Si está ocultando algo, es igual que mentir.
cards.back: Let me remind you that you are in a court of law. If you're holding back any information, it's as good as lying.

cards.front: Ella contuvo las lágrimas mientras estaba en la oficina, y nada más llegar a su casa, se echó a llorar.
cards.back: She held back her tears while she was in the office, and as soon as she got home, she burst out crying.

cards.front: Si hubieras ocultado esa información en el tribunal, los culpables habrían salido impunes.
cards.back: If you'd held back that information in court, then the culprits would have gotten off scot-free.

cards.front: Él es totalmente incapaz de desempeñar un trabajo. Pero ahora que va a ser padre, más vale que empiece a hacer lo que le corresponde.
cards.back: He's totally incapable of holding down a job. But now that he's going to become a father, he'd better start pulling his weight!

cards.front: ¡Espero que valores que yo esté desempeñando tres trabajos para llevar algo de comer a la mesa, chaval!
cards.back: I hope you appreciate the fact that I'm holding down three jobs in order to put food on this table, young man!

cards.front: Ella hizo lo que podía por detenerle hasta que llegara la policía, pero huyó. ¡Menos mal que tropezó!
cards.back: She tried as hard as she could to hold him down until the police arrived, but he got away. It's a good thing he tripped!

cards.front: Él preferiría pasar el resto de su vida solo a estar mal acompañado. Por eso lleva años esperando a que llegue la buena.
cards.back: He'd rather spend the rest of his life alone than be with the wrong woman, so he's been holding out for the right one for years.

cards.front: Desde que me gradué en la facultad, las ofertas de trabajo han estado entrando a raudales, pero estoy reservándome para el trabajo de mis sueños.
cards.back: Since I graduated from University, the job offers have been flooding in, but I'm holding out for my dream job.

cards.front: Estoy esperando a un héroe hasta la luz de la mañana. Tiene que ser fuerte y tiene que ser rápido.
cards.back: I'm holding out for a hero until the morning light. He's got to be strong and he's got to be fast.

cards.front: Yo que tú esperaría un poco antes de invertir en propiedades. Es que no es el momento adecuado.
cards.back: If I were you, I'd hold off investing any of my money in property for now. It's just not the right time.

cards.front: Debido a la recesión, mucha gente ha pospuesto hacer el tipo de inversión que podría volver a encarrilar la economía.
cards.back: Due to the recession, many people have held off making the type of investments that could really get the economy back on track.

cards.front: Pensaba que aguantaría sin llover al menos hasta que regresáramos al coche.
cards.back: I thought that the rain would hold off at least until we got back to the car.

cards.front: Agárrate a mi brazo o si no te caerás.
cards.back: Grab hold of my arm; you'll fall over otherwise.

cards.front: ¿Me puedes coger el volante un segundo?
cards.back: Can you take hold of the steering wheel for me?

cards.front: Sabes que cuando la jefa te coja te va a leer la cartilla.
cards.back: You know when the boss catches hold of you she's going to give you what for.

cards.front: No sueltes mi cartera y mis llaves mientras estamos en la montaña rusa.
cards.back: Keep hold of my wallet and keys while we're on the rollercoaster.

cards.front: No sé qué le pasa a mi hijo Dick, no parece capaz de mantener a ninguna de las chicas con las que sale.
cards.back: I don't know what's wrong with my little Dick; he never seems to be able to keep hold of any girls he goes out with.

cards.front: Él es un buen partido; asegúrate de que no se te escape.
cards.back: He's a good catch; make sure you keep hold of him.

cards.front: ¿Dónde conseguiste estos altavoces? Son geniales.
cards.back: Where did you get hold of these speakers? They're great!

cards.front: ¿Alguien sabe dónde podría conseguir un esmoquin antes de la fiesta de esta noche?
cards.back: Does anyone know where I could get hold of a dinner suit before this evening's party?

cards.front: No sé de dónde sacaste la idea de que nos iban a despedir por reducción de plantilla.
cards.back: I don't know where you got hold of the idea that we were going to be made redundant.

cards.front: ¿Todavía no has logrado localizar a Bertie? De verdad, necesito hablar con él cuanto antes.
cards.back: Haven't you managed to get hold of Bertie yet? I really need to speak to him as soon as possible.

cards.front: Cuando localice a los niños que pintaron con spray mi coche, los voy a matar.
cards.back: When I get hold of the kids who spray-painted my car, I'm going to kill them.

cards.front: ¿Sabes dónde podría localizar a un buen fontanero que además sea honrado?
cards.back: Do you know where I could get hold of a decent plumber who is honest too?

cards.front: Ella tiene que aprender a controlarse, de lo contrario va a perder su trabajo.
cards.back: She has to learn to get a hold of herself or she's going to lose her job.

cards.front: Intenta calmarte un poco porque no he entendido ni una palabra de lo que has dicho hasta el momento.
cards.back: Try and get a hold of yourself because I haven't understood a word you've said so far.

cards.front: ¿Logró controlarse anoche después de que nos fuéramos de la fiesta? Se estaba comportando como un auténtico loco.
cards.back: Did he manage to get a hold of himself last night after we left the party? He was acting like a total lunatic.

cards.front: Cuando se encontraron se abrazaron apasionadamente.
cards.back: When they met they embraced each other passionately.

cards.front: No podemos tener miedo de estos cambios; tenemos que abrazarlos.
cards.back: We can't be frightened of these changes; we need to embrace them.

cards.front: Fue un poco raro ver a esos dos rivales políticos abrazarse así.
cards.back: It was a little strange to see those two political rivals embrace each other like that.

cards.front: No necesito que te disculpes; sólo quiero que me abraces.
cards.back: I don't need you to apologise; I just want you to hug me.

cards.front: ¿Fuiste tú a quien vi anoche abrazando a Sally en la estación de trenes?
cards.back: Was that you I saw hugging Sally at the train station last night?

cards.front: Cuando dije que eras un «abrazador de árboles», me refería a que te preocupa mucho el medioambiente; ¡no lo quería decir en el sentido literal!
cards.back: When I said that you're a "tree hugger" it meant that you are worried about the environment; I didn't mean it literally!

cards.front: La policía ha detenido a tres sospechosos en relación con el robo de Dalston.
cards.back: Police have detained three suspects in relation to the Dalston robbery.

cards.front: ¿Durante cuánto tiempo te detuvieron?
cards.back: How long did they detain you for?

cards.front: Te estamos arrestando por presunto asesinato.
cards.back: We're detaining you on a charge of murder.

cards.front: Agárrate a mi brazo y no te caerás.
cards.back: Cling on to my arm and you won't fall!

cards.front: A pesar de las manifestaciones violentas y las huelgas, el dictador brutal sigue aferrado al poder.
cards.back: Despite the violent protests and the strikes, the brutal dictator is still clinging on to power.

cards.front: Ella sigue aferrada a la esperanza de que su marido vuelva con ella.
cards.back: She still clings to the hope that her husband will come back to her.

cards.front: Siempre que se pone nervioso aprieta los puños.
cards.back: Whenever he gets nervous, he clenches his fists.

cards.front: Cuando él me da la mano la aprieta tanto que me duele.
cards.back: When he shakes my hand, he clenches it so hard that it hurts.

cards.front: ¡La gente aprieta las nalgas cuando miente!
cards.back: People clench their buttocks when they lie!

cards.front: Su razonamiento no se sostiene. Si lo piensas, sus argumentos no se mantienen a flote.
cards.back: His reasoning is based on shaky premises. If you think about it, his arguments don't hold water.

cards.front: ¿Has explorado todos los distintos resultados posibles? Tienes que asegurarte de que tu teoría se mantiene a flote.
cards.back: Did you explore all the different potential outcomes? You need to make sure your theory holds water.

cards.front: Las razones que ella daba para apoyar esta política no se mantenían a flote porque no tenían sustento.
cards.back: The reasons she gave for supporting this policy didn't hold water because they were based on shaky premises.

cards.front: Aunque sabía que podría ir a la cárcel, se defendió a sí mismo en el interrogatorio.
cards.back: Even though he knew he might go to prison, he held his own in the interrogation.

cards.front: Sus competidores tenían experiencia, pero ella se defendió a pesar de no ser favorita.
cards.back: Her competitors were experienced, but she held her own despite being an underdog.

cards.front: El candidato menos favorito se defendió y acabó siendo el ganador.
cards.back: The underdog held his own and eventually came out as the winner.

cards.front: ¿Por qué le sigues teniendo en gran estima? Tuvo que ir a la cárcel porque sus declaraciones en el juicio no se sostenían.
cards.back: Why do you still hold him in high regard? He had to go to prison because his declarations in court didn't hold water.

cards.front: Sabes que valoro mucho tu opinión, pero, con todo el respeto, no puedo permitir que eso ocurra.
cards.back: You know that I hold your opinion in high regard, but with all due respect, I can't let that happen.

cards.front: Nelson Mandela goza de una alta estima en todo el mundo por su papel en la derrota del Apartheid.
cards.back: Nelson Mandela is held in high regard all over the world for his role in bringing Apartheid to an end.

cards.front: Ella guardaba rencor a su compañera de trabajo, a la que ascendieron sólo por su atractivo.
cards.back: She held a grudge against her co-worker who got promoted only because of her good looks.

cards.front: ¡No me puedo creer que todavía le guardes rencor a ella! ¡La ascendieron hace muchísimo!
cards.back: I can't believe you're still holding a grudge against her! She got promoted ages ago!

cards.front: La ascendieron por la investigación que hizo sobre el tema, así que no le deberías haber guardado rencor.
cards.back: She got promoted because of the research she had done on the subject, so you shouldn't have held a grudge against her.

cards.front: Le dijeron a ella que podía decir lo que quisiera, sin ninguna limitación.
cards.back: She was told that she could say anything she liked, no holds barred.

cards.front: En el DVD hay una entrevista con Kurt Cobain en la que habla de todo y grabaciones entre bambalinas.
cards.back: On the DVD there's a no-holds-barred interview with Kurt Cobain and backstage footage.

cards.front: Este documental es una película educativa contundente, sin restricciones sobre las drogas que más se consumen.
cards.back: This documentary is a hard-hitting, no-holds-barred educational film about the most commonly abused drugs.
